jia: heads-up — during int4 bring-up for rwd-v2-small-quant I'm seeing token misalignment after ~1500 tokens in our strided prefill test. Repro below, logs show `kv index mismatch at 1536`. anyone run into this? :eyes:

alex: can you paste the minimal prompt + seed and the rotary/rope config? also which quant backend?

jia: minimal prompt is short ("Summarize the following long doc..."), seed=42. Quant backend=custom-int4-block (block_size=16). config snippet:
```
model: rwd-v2-small-quant
prefill: { stride: 1024, prefill_stride: 256 }
rope: { base: 10000, scale: dynamic }
quant: { mode: int4, block: 16, dequantize_on_prefill: false }
```
failing log excerpt:
```
E [2134567895] kv_cache.cpp:write_kv: kv index mismatch at 1536 (expected 1472)
W [2134567895] decode.cpp:sample: token_drop detected near token 1538
```

marta: ran a quick local sweep. with stride=1024 I see a persistent 64-offset write when sequence > 1024 — looks like an alignment/memcpy corner case when quant blocks cross a 64-byte boundary. try prefill_stride=512 to see if the offset moves. sample diff I saw (fp16 vs int4):
```
FP16: "...the protein folds into a stable domain."
INT4: "...the protein folds into a . domain."  <-- token dropped and extra punctuation
```

ci-bot: CI: long-prefill-int4-check for PR #4212 finished — 1 failure (kv-align). log: https://ci.internal/runs/4212 :warning:

sam: can we bisect whether this is RoPE scaling interacting with int4 packing? try FP16 (baseline), int4 with rope scale on, int4 with rope scale off. if disabling scaling fixes it, that points to RoPE math + quantized memcpy ordering.

jia: running the sweep now across 3 variants (fp16, int4+rope_scale, int4+rope_off). early metrics (validation perplexity on long-doc set, 2k tokens):
- fp16: ppl=12.3
- int4+rope_scale:on: ppl=37.8 (bad)
- int4+rope_scale:off: ppl=13.0

also quick token diff around the boundary (tokens ~1500-1510):
```
FP16: ... "and then the committee voted to approve the amendment."
INT4+scale:on: ... "and then the committee voted to approve the" 
INT4+scale:off: ... "and then the committee voted to approve the amendment."
```
this strongly suggests the scaling path + quant memcpy/order is corrupting the kv entries used for attention at long offsets. :bug:

alex: great repro, thanks. can you upload the raw kv tensor dumps (before/after) for step 1500 and 1536? I'll add a memcopy alignment unit test and check our int4 write/read code path. tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml. @marta can you try an aligned-copy patch locally (force 64-byte-aligned buffers) to see if it mitigates?

marta: will try aligned-copy and report, ETA ~2h.

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-2387: "int4 prefill kv write/read misalignment with rope_scaling" assigned to alex. link: https://issues.internal/INF-2387 :white_check_mark:

jia: thanks everyone — leaving the sweep running overnight with more seeds and longer sequences (up to 8k). will post full diffs and KV dumps here when done.
